args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py failures in the nightly build.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN as required by FIN-212.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` imported and used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring (and FIN-212) requiring banker's rounding.
- Switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which expects e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66` (half rounds to even), not `2.67`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed on this branch.

## References
- FIN-212
